ex.en: His story was consistent with the facts, so the police believed him.
ex.zh: 他的说法与事实相符，所以警方相信了他。

words.note: consistent with 表「与…相符」，in 表示「在…方面」。

ex.en: After losing his job, he was on the dole for almost a year.
ex.zh: 失业后，他靠领救济金生活了近一年。

words.note: dole out 指少量分发钱物；on the dole 是英式口语「领失业救济」。

ex.en: The government hopes to reverse the trend of falling birth rates this year.
ex.zh: 政府希望今年扭转出生率下降的趋势。

words.note: in reverse 表「反向地」；reverse a decision 指撤销一项决定。

ex.en: Nothing grows on this barren land, and the farmers have moved to the city.
ex.zh: 这片贫瘠的土地上什么也长不出来，农民们已迁往城市。

words.note: barren 指土地贫瘠或徒劳无果；bare 是「光秃的」，两词勿混。

ex.en: The poem describes love as an eternal force that outlasts everything else.
ex.zh: 这首诗把爱描述为超越一切、永恒的力量。

words.note: eternal 强调无始无终；permanent 侧重「非临时的、长期不变」。

ex.en: She finally found a permanent job after working on short contracts for years.
ex.zh: 做了几年短期合同工后，她终于找到一份固定工作。

words.note: 反义词为 temporary；permanent address 指永久住址。

ex.en: The program aims to foster cooperation between local schools and businesses.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在促进当地学校与企业之间的合作。

words.note: foster 作动词多表「培养、促进」；foster parents 指养父母。

ex.en: We had barely enough money to pay the rent that month.
ex.zh: 那个月我们的钱勉强够付房租。

words.note: barely 含否定意味，barely enough 是「勉强够」，不是「足够」。

ex.en: This belief is still prevalent among older members of the community.
ex.zh: 这种看法在社区年长者中仍然普遍。

words.note: prevalent 常与 among、in 连用；比 common 更强调「广泛存在」。

ex.en: The little boy clings to his mother's hand whenever the street is busy.
ex.zh: 街上人多时，小男孩总是紧紧抓着母亲的手。

words.note: cling 的过去式和过去分词为 clung；cling to 可接具体物或抽象之物。

ex.en: The incidence of skin cancer has risen sharply in recent decades.
ex.zh: 近几十年来皮肤癌的发生率急剧上升。

words.note: incidence 指疾病等的发生频率，与 incident（事件）不同。

ex.en: He fastened the pages together with a paper clip before handing them in.
ex.zh: 交之前他用回形针把这几页别在一起。

words.note: clip 兼指「夹子」和「片段」；video clip 是常见搭配。

ex.en: A narrow beam of light came through the hole in the roof.
ex.zh: 一束窄光从屋顶的洞中照了进来。

words.note: beam 指光束或房屋横梁；beam with pride 是「满脸自豪」。

ex.en: This compact camera fits easily into a coat pocket and takes sharp photos.
ex.zh: 这款小巧的相机能轻松放进外套口袋，拍出的照片很清晰。

words.note: compact 表「紧凑、小巧」；作名词时重音前移，指化妆粉盒或契约。

ex.en: The two parties formed an alliance to win the coming election.
ex.zh: 两党结成联盟，以赢得即将到来的选举。

words.note: 常与 form、enter into 搭配；in alliance with 表与…联合。

ex.en: Her advice was invaluable when I was preparing for the interview.
ex.zh: 我准备面试时，她的建议非常宝贵。

words.note: invaluable 是「极宝贵」而非「无价值」，此处 in- 不表否定。

ex.en: He reads science fiction every night before going to sleep.
ex.zh: 他每晚睡前都读科幻小说。

words.note: fiction 指虚构小说，与 non-fiction（纪实作品）相对。

ex.en: Without new investment, the project seems doomed to failure.
ex.zh: 没有新的投资，这个项目似乎注定要失败。

words.note: be doomed to 后接名词或动词原形；doom and gloom 指悲观论调。

ex.en: She stayed as cool as a cucumber during the whole interview.
ex.zh: 整个面试过程中她镇定自若。

words.note: as cool as a cucumber 是习语，指「十分镇定」。

ex.en: The aviation industry has recovered faster than many experts expected.
ex.zh: 航空业的复苏比许多专家预想的更快。

words.note: aviation 源自拉丁语 avis（鸟），多用于航空业、民航等正式语境。

ex.en: Economists are pessimistic about the chances of a quick recovery.
ex.zh: 经济学家对经济迅速复苏的可能性持悲观态度。

words.note: pessimistic 常与 about 连用，反义词为 optimistic。

ex.en: In this chart, a red line denotes the level of air pollution.
ex.zh: 在这张图中，红线表示空气污染的水平。

words.note: denote 多用于书面语表「标示、代表」，与 indicate 近义。

ex.en: The report places great emphasis on the need for cleaner energy.
ex.zh: 这份报告高度重视对清洁能源的需求。

words.note: 搭配 place/lay emphasis on；emphasize 是其动词形式。

ex.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the manager needs to speak with you now.
ex.zh: 抱歉打扰一下，经理现在需要跟你谈谈。

words.note: interrupt 指打断正在进行的言行；disturb 侧重打扰、妨碍。

ex.en: Social media can propagate false information faster than any newspaper.
ex.zh: 社交媒体传播虚假信息比任何报纸都快。

words.note: propagate 本义指植物繁殖，引申为思想、信息的传播。

ex.en: Engineers are still checking whether the design is technically feasible.
ex.zh: 工程师们仍在检验这一设计在技术上是否可行。

words.note: 常修饰 plan、scheme、proposal；名词为 feasibility。

ex.en: Tourists come from everywhere to admire the majesty of these mountains.
ex.zh: 游客从各地前来欣赏这些群山的雄伟。

words.note: 当面称呼国王或女王用 Your Majesty，回指用 His/Her Majesty。

ex.en: I was flattered by the invitation to speak at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 受邀在典礼上讲话，我感到很荣幸。

words.note: flatter 指「奉承」，也表「使感到荣幸」；由 flat 加 -er 构成。

ex.en: The company is looking for new ways to reach potential customers abroad.
ex.zh: 公司正在寻找接触海外潜在客户的新途径。

words.note: potential 作名词时不可数，常与 realize、reach 搭配表「发挥潜力」。

ex.en: The delay will necessitate a change in our travel plans.
ex.zh: 这一延误将使我们不得不调整旅行计划。

words.note: necessitate 后接名词或动名词；比 need 更正式，多用于书面语。
